hook: The 3-question test before you spend a dime on ads.
direction: (1) Are people already searching for what you offer? (2) Can the budget survive your niche's cost-per-click? (3) Does the landing page convert? Two noes = wait. Note the Google Ad Grant for eligible nonprofits — $10K/month most never claim properly.

facebook.text:
Before you spend a dime on Google Ads, answer three questions honestly.

1. Are people already searching for what you offer? If there's no search demand, ads won't create it.
2. Can your budget survive the cost-per-click in your niche? Some industries run $15–40 per click. Do the math before you commit.
3. Does your landing page actually convert? Sending paid traffic to a weak page is just paying to lose faster.

Two no's means wait. Fix the foundation first.

One note for nonprofits: Google's Ad Grant offers up to $10,000/month in free search advertising to eligible organizations. Most never claim it properly. If that's you, it's worth a serious look.

instagram.text:
Three questions before you run Google Ads.

1. Are people searching for what you offer?
2. Can your budget handle the cost-per-click in your niche?
3. Does your landing page convert?

Two no's means wait. Ads amplify what's already working — they don't fix what isn't.

And if you're a nonprofit: Google's Ad Grant gives eligible organizations up to $10K/month in free search ads. Most never claim it correctly. Worth looking into.
